name: experiment-prereg
title_zh: GPU 开机前先冻结实验判据的预注册清单
tagline_zh: 跑 ablation 前把主指标、最小效应量、停止规则写死并封存。防止把 rollout 当独立样本的伪重复。
tagline_en: Lock down primary metric, MDE, stopping rules before compute. Kills pseudoreplication from treating rollouts as.
desc_en: Pre-registration for an experiment: before the compute is spent, write down and freeze the primary metric, the minimum detectable effect, what counts as null, the stopping and decision rules, and the evaluation protocol. Blocks the pseudoreplication of treating rollouts as independent samples. Use before committing GPU time, when designing an ablation or benchmark comparison, or when reproduced nu
why_zh: 它把「决定何时停」从跑完后的后悔，变成跑之前的一道物理闸门——先冻结再开机，比任何事后校正都硬。
why_en: It turns stopping decisions into a physical gate before compute starts—freeze first, then run. Harder than any post-hoc.
limit_zh: 只覆盖实验设计阶段的判据冻结，不生成统计代码、不算样本量、不替代 IRB。若你已跑完或只做探索性分析，它只会挡路。
limit_en: Only freezes criteria pre-run. No stats code, no power calc, no IRB. If you've already run or are exploring, it just gets in the way.
title_en: Freeze your experiment criteria before spending GPU
